items.name: pill-toggle
items.title: Pill Toggle
items.description: A two-position rocker for light and dark mode. The active half sinks in with an inset shadow.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types and deletes strings in sequence, looping through an array. Configurable speed and cursor.

items.name: pulsating-button
items.title: Pulsating Button
items.description: A button that emits an expanding ring. Pulse or ripple, any color. Ships its own keyframes.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Magnetic Button
items.description: The wrapped element is pulled toward the cursor and springs back on leave. Respects reduced motion.

items.name: ship-toggle
items.title: Ship Toggle
items.description: A tactile two-state switch (draft to shipped). The knob slides between halves with a spring.

items.name: css-box
items.title: CSS Box
items.description: A draggable 3D cube in pure CSS perspective. Accepts any React node on each face.

items.name: dither-image
items.title: Dither Image
items.description: Renders any image as a two-tone, Bayer-dithered stipple on a canvas. Ink on paper by default.

items.name: rage-button
items.title: Rage Button
items.description: A button that snaps down on press and spits a burst of particles. Ship angry.

items.name: social-buttons
items.title: Social Buttons
items.description: A row of social links — monochrome at rest, each blooms into its real brand hue on hover (Instagram gets its authentic gradient). Inline brand glyphs, zero dependencies.

items.name: memoji-widget
items.title: Memoji Widget
items.description: A floating, draggable avatar that opens an introduction panel: a spinning 3D globe, reveal rows, profile cards, an intro video, and an email composer. Generic copy, pass your own name, avatar, and links. Pulls in the globe and tooltip from this registry.

items.name: wordmark-panel
items.title: Wordmark Panel
items.description: A project-style panel titled with a colorful pixel wordmark. Drop any graphic in as the face. Pulls the pixel font via next/font.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: An iOS pill thumb that spring-slides under the live segment, dividers dissolving as it passes.

items.name: animated-counter
items.title: Animated Counter
items.description: An odometer with real spring physics. Each digit rolls the short way and rests on crisp integers.

items.name: spotlight-card
items.title: Spotlight Card
items.description: A card that catches the light: the border trails your cursor with real weight.

items.name: shimmer-button
items.title: Shimmer Button
items.description: A single light comet glides around the border while the face catches a glint on hover.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: Leans toward your cursor in real 3D, catches a soft glare, and springs back flat when you leave.

items.name: confetti-button
items.title: Confetti Button
items.description: Click it anywhere and a physics confetti spray erupts from the exact pixel you hit. No library.

items.name: hue-slider
items.title: Hue Slider
items.description: A range input whose track is the colour wheel, with a live swatch that glows in the picked hue.

items.name: snap-back-card
items.title: Snap-back Card
items.description: Wrap anything to drag it anywhere on the page, then spring it right back to where it started.

items.name: wave-fill
items.title: Wave Fill
items.description: Animated waving water that fills any container from the bottom, with two parallax crests.

items.name: bubble-field
items.title: Bubble Field
items.description: A lightweight layer of bubbles that rise and wobble up through any container, then loop.

items.name: aurora
items.title: Aurora
items.description: Soft, slow-drifting ribbons of colour that glow behind content like the northern lights.

items.name: weather-stack
items.title: Weather Stack
items.description: A frosted-glass weather + local-time widget. Seattle is fixed; add any city with live geocoded search or your own location, each ticking on its own timezone.

items.name: weather-scene
items.title: Weather Scene
items.description: A looping gif or image with the frosted-glass weather widget floating over it, as one joint component.

items.name: purchase-button
items.title: Purchase Button
items.description: A confident green call to action with a cart glyph and a springy press. Renders an anchor when a href is set, a button otherwise.

items.name: coffee-button
items.title: Coffee Button
items.description: A frosted-glass support button built to sit over imagery: white text on a translucent, blurred surface with a gentle press.

items.name: read-more-button
items.title: Read More Button
items.description: A small pill link whose trailing book icon is closed at rest and opens with a gentle upward lift on hover.

items.name: book-cover
items.title: Book Cover
items.description: A cover image that lifts and pops on hover, then morphs open into a detail dialog with title, author, blurb, and a purchase link. Self-contained morph, no dialog dependency.

items.name: spinning-globe
items.title: Spinning Globe
items.description: A clean line globe whose meridians scroll inside a circular clip, so it reads as rotating on its axis. Spins on hover or on a prop; stills under reduced motion.

items.name: samuel-wordmark
items.title: Samuel Wordmark
items.description: A name set in a single editorial serif italic, built to run large and centered as a masthead. Pulls the serif via next/font.

items.name: writing-wordmark
items.title: Writing Wordmark
items.description: A word in a warm handwriting signature, the informal counterpart to a serif masthead. Pulls the script face via next/font.

items.name: chopsticks-wordmark
items.title: Chopsticks Wordmark
items.description: A rounded, friendly bot lockup: a light-blue Nunito name with a small badge alongside. Self-contained via next/font.

items.name: sandbox-wordmark
items.title: Sandbox Wordmark
items.description: A chunky, glossy beach-toy wordmark: rounded Nunito, primary toy colors per letter, a gentle alternating tilt, and a drop shadow.

items.name: components-wordmark
items.title: Components Wordmark
items.description: A clean product lockup: a small tracked eyebrow over a two-part name with an accent token. Relabel via props.

items.name: just-for-fun-wordmark
items.title: Just For Fun Wordmark
items.description: A friendly rounded lockup with an italic last word underlined by a hand-drawn squiggle that scales with the type. Self-contained via next/font.

items.name: pixel-wordmark
items.title: Pixel Wordmark
items.description: A blocky arcade pixel wordmark where each letter is tinted from a cycling palette. Pulls the pixel font via next/font.

items.name: flags
items.title: Flags
items.description: An overlapping stack of inline-SVG US, France, and Malaysia flags that fans out into an even row on group hover. Black border in light mode, white in dark.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Reveal
items.description: A scroll and mount triggered fade-up wrapper with a staggered index delay and reduced-motion support.

items.name: free-tag
items.title: Free Tag
items.description: A manila hang-tag on twine that tugs toward your cursor and snaps back with elastic rubber-band physics.

items.name: site-cursor
items.title: Site Cursor
items.description: A custom follower cursor: a dot that expands into a label when hovering interactive elements.

items.name: hand-write
items.title: Handwriting
items.description: A ghost hand writes a phrase in white marker one letter at a time, arc-length timed for constant pen velocity, then a whiteboard eraser scrubs it away in serpentine passes. Frosted play, pause, and replay control.

items.name: push-button
items.title: Push Button
items.description: A tactile round push button. The face sits raised on a hard shadow and sinks flush on press, like a real physical key. Ships its own styles.

items.name: samuel-widget
items.title: Samuel Widget
items.description: A draggable memoji that opens into a little messenger: profile, Seattle time and weather, a 3D globe, and an intro video.

items.name: wok-logo
items.title: Wok Logo
items.description: A minimal wok mark with rising steam lines that renders in the current text color.

items.name: cat-mark
items.title: Cat Mark
items.description: A side-profile cat silhouette with ears, four legs, and a curling tail, filled in the current text color.

items.name: samuel-ui-wordmark
items.title: UI Components Wordmark
items.description: A cohesive Nunito lockup with a small blue UI chip, em-relative so it scales from panel title to page hero.

items.name: design-wordmark
items.title: Design Wordmark
items.description: The word Design in tight Inter with a thin rainbow prism bar that holographically drifts through the spectrum.

items.name: video-player
items.title: Video Player
items.description: Custom video chrome over a native player: click to play, a draggable scrubber, time, and volume.

items.name: animated-theme-toggler
items.title: Animated Theme Toggler
items.description: A theme switch that wipes the new theme in from the button with the View Transitions API.

items.name: cursor
items.title: Cursor
items.description: A custom follower that trails the pointer. Attach it to any container.

items.name: dynamic-toolbar
items.title: Dynamic Island Toolbar
items.description: The original personal-site Toolbar, unchanged, with its actual supporting sources and integration guide. Next.js App Router required.

items.name: morphing-dialog
items.title: Morphing Dialog
items.description: A trigger that grows into a full dialog with a shared layout morph.

items.name: background-effects
items.title: Background Effects
items.description: A single canvas particle engine with eight ambient effects (snow, rain, embers, aurora, dither, stars, bubbles, mist). Theme-aware, reduced-motion safe, and parked to the document so effects scroll with the page.

items.name: qp-dither
items.title: Qp Dither
items.description: A Bayer 4x4 ordered dither of a blackletter logo mark. Every kept pixel becomes a dot that scatters on load and converges from the center out, breathes on its own phase, and eases away from the cursor.

items.name: cat-cursor
items.title: Cat Cursor
items.description: A pixel cat that chases your cursor, sits when it catches up, and naps when idle. Ships with the oneko sprite.

items.name: globe-3d
items.title: 3D Globe
items.description: A draggable WebGL earth with Apple Maps-style location pins and idle auto-rotation.

items.name: canvas-reveal-effect
items.title: Canvas Reveal Effect
items.description: An animated dot-matrix reveal rendered with a WebGL fragment shader.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: The workhorse button with six variants and five sizes.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field with a focus ring and invalid states.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A controlled range slider with a square thumb.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A portalled Base UI tooltip with a canonical dark pill and a Tip one-liner wrapper.

items.name: toaster
items.title: Toaster
items.description: A sonner toaster wired to the theme and popover tokens, with lucide status icons.

items.name: web-haptics-demo
items.title: Web Haptics
items.description: A synthesized UI sound pack, no audio files. Warm oscillator cues laddered by weight, with a playable grid and a live toggle, slider, and confirm.

items.name: agent-roster
items.title: Agent Roster
items.description: A marquee row of pixel-art avatar faces riding a conveyor belt, with edge blur, play/pause, and a speed slider. Each face plays its GIF on hover.

items.name: prose-kit
items.title: Prose Kit
items.description: An inline rich-text toolkit: colored words, display-face words, hover tooltips, and vector media placeholders for post bodies.

items.name: ig-gradient
items.title: Instagram Gradient
items.description: A hidden SVG defs block exposing the authentic Instagram brand gradient as url(#ig-gradient), so any glyph or shape can fill with it.

items.name: reading-gif-panel
items.title: Reading GIF Panel
items.description: The original samhc.us reading panel, with all five social buttons, the train GIF, overlapping book covers, and morphing purchase dialogs. Original sources and assets preserved.
